name: print-social-purple-hiring-web-banner-with-man-on-beanbag
title: Purple 'We Are Hiring!' web banner with a man pointing from a purple beanbag
whatItIs: A wide purple web banner with an orange and white headline ('WE ARE HIRING! Join Our CREATIVE & Professional Team!'), orange icon contact rows, a translucent 'Open Positions' panel, and a smiling man with headphones on a purple beanbag pointing at the list with a laptop on his lap.
whatItMeans: Casual and fun; the beanbag and pointing gesture promise a relaxed creative culture.
techniques: Have the subject point toward the key content.
Match furniture to the background colour.
Pair orange accents with a purple base.

vocabulary.definition: A pose pointing the eye toward content.
A wide image at the top of a page.
